_comment: Advisories consciously accepted, with an expiry so they resurface instead of
being forgotten. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails CI on anything not listed here,
and also fails on an entry whose reviewBy date has passed.
Every entry must state why it is not exploitable here, or what blocks the fix.

allow.reason: RSC-mode CSRF. Not reachable: this is a client-only SPA using BrowserRouter, with no RSC, no data router, no loaders and no actions. The fix is react-router 8.3.0, which drops react-router-dom and is a framework migration rather than a version bump.

Dev-only transitive via eslint; not shipped to the browser. The fixed version is less than 7 days old and is therefore held back by min-release-age in .npmrc. Expires quickly on purpose: once the fix ages in, a plain lockfile refresh clears it.
